name: mystarswim
description: Star Swim scheduler, attendance PWA, parent app and public intake. Static files served by Netlify; this file exists only to pin what build.js and the tests need.

scripts.build: node build.js app.js app.compiled.js && node build.js intake.js intake.compiled.js
scripts.check: node build.js app.js app.compiled.js --check && node build.js intake.js intake.compiled.js --check

//: Babel is pinned to 7, exactly, and not by preference. app.compiled.js and
intake.compiled.js are committed, and build.js reproduces them byte for byte
only with preset-react's useSpread option. Babel 8 removed that option and
refuses to build at all, so an unpinned install does not degrade quietly --
it stops. Which is the better of the two failures, but still a stop.
react and react-dom are here for the tests, not for the pages: the pages load
18.2.0 from a CDN the sandbox cannot reach, and tests/browser.js answers those
requests from node_modules instead. The versions have to match the CDN tags in
app.html and intake.html, or the tests drive a different React from the one
